entries.source: Otto Stolz, Die Ausbreitung des Deutschtums in Südtirol im Lichte der Urkunden, vol. 3, part 2, Urkundenbeilagen und Nachträge, 1932; Regest no. 13s; cited original: notarial record at Kloster Fiecht archive
entries.english: In Bolzano, the brothers Adelpert and Engelmar of Placedello sell a plot at Campo Polecho, at the place called of der Ade, to St Georgenberg Abbey. Enricus de Rosenpacho is among the witnesses.

facts.subject: Heinrich de Rosenpacho
facts.content: appears among the witnesses to the sale.
